title: Blender pipeline
summary: Models as Python: tools/blender/build.sh + kit_base.py (palette materials, primitives, pivots, glb export) + example model + --preview PNGs (never a window)
claude_md: - Own 3D models are Python scripts in `tools/blender/models/`, built headless with `tools/blender/build.sh [--preview] [name]`; never open the Blender UI.
